# Steps 
1. Confirm indication & gestational age 
	- ind: GDM, HTN, PROM, postdates 
	- use age from 1st trimester US 

2. Assess cervix
	- dilation, effacement, station, consistency, position
	- Bishop > 6

3. (opt) Choose cervical ripening method 
	
--- start-multi-column: ID_83k0
```column-settings
Number of Columns: 2
Largest Column: standard
```

mechanical
- foley 
- Cook 

--- column-break ---

pharmacologic 
- prostaglandins (miso/dino)

--- end-multi-column

4. Choose induction agent 
	- oxytocin (pitocin)
	- amniotomy 

5. Monitor 
	- Fetal: EFM 
	- Uterine: 3-5 CTX/mm, 40-60 s/CTX 
	- Maternal: VS, WBC/fever 

6. Assess labor progress 
	- serial cervical exams q4h 
	- if arrest of dilation: consider cesarean 

# Adjuncts 
- pain mgmt 
- hydration / nutrition 
- emotional support
